meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 技能会把旧版 NanoClaw 和 Claude 的记忆文件（如 .seed.md、CLAUDE.md 等）迁移到统一的共享记忆树，整理并建立索引。它会先暂停相关任务，移动文件，重新组织内容，最后生成报告供确认，确保切换 provider 后记忆不丢失。
howto.when: 更新后报告共享记忆出现不兼容变更，或群组仍有遗留记忆文件（如 .seed.md、CLAUDE.md 等），或你说“迁移记忆”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 把旧记忆迁移到新共享记忆树。
say.note: 技能会扫描并迁移遗留文件。

say.text: 整合 CLAUDE.md 里的内容到新记忆系统。
say.note: 会合并到标准记忆文件。

say.text: 迁移后我还能记得之前的事吗？

howto.what_en: Migrates legacy NanoClaw/Claude memory files (e.g., .seed.md, CLAUDE.md) into the shared memory tree, reorganizing and indexing them. Pauses tasks, moves files, organizes content, and reports for approval, preserving memory across provider switches.
howto.when_en: Triggers after an update reports a shared-memory breaking change, when a group still has legacy memory files (e.g., .seed.md, CLAUDE.md), or when you mention 'migrate memory' or other keywords.

say_en.text: Migrate old memory to the new shared memory tree.
Merge CLAUDE.md contents into the new memory system.
Can I still remember previous things after migration?
